candidates.title: [ux-sim] Sign-up shows "1 of 6" up front and puts the account last; both cold-start personas quit or nearly quit in setup
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

The reworked /start (goals → what Lumi can do → university → discover → communities → account) still has six screens before an account. Jordan quit on screen 4 (a second interest picker); Diego skipped twice and arrived with most patience spent.

Severity **4** (Blocker — I could not continue, gave up, or would stop using the app here.) · analyst confidence high · **2 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Profiling before value; "1 of 6" makes the length explicit; the discover picker repeats the goals screen; the tour opens on Classes even after "Meet new people".

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout` step 12 — “four screens in and I haven't seen a single human. this is the part where I delete it.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout/shots/012-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout/shots/012-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout` step 1 — “1 of 6?? six screens before I even see anything. ugh.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout/shots/001-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout/shots/001-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout` step 4 — “I said meet people. why are you showing me calculus. skip.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout/shots/004-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout/shots/004-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261106-1915-diego-cold-start-hangout` step 13 — “Still no account. I'm hitting Skip. Nine taps in and I haven't seen a single person.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-diego-cold-start-hangout/shots/013-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-diego-cold-start-hangout/shots/013-click-som.jpg)

Runs: [`sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-cold-start-hangout/report.md), [`sched-20261106-1915-diego-cold-start-hangout`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-diego-cold-start-hangout/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `jordan-sophomore-impatient`, `diego-transfer-commuter` · scenarios: `cold-start-hangout`

### Environment note

Same on live.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Drop or merge the discover picker into goals; open the tour on the tab matching the chosen goal; show something real (this week on campus) before the optional screens.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Club pages are empty past the join button: no dated events, no members, organizers "not on Lumi yet"
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Jordan (Cal Hacks) and Minji (KSA): Events, Members and About tabs empty; "Organizers aren't on Lumi yet · requests are saved and passed on" made them doubt anyone reads the request. Same problem as 2026-11-02.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence high · **2 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Clubs come from official lists without officers; the page shows empty tabs instead of the club's own links and meeting times.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261106-1915-jordan-find-a-club` step 7 — “no events. for the biggest hackathon club. so nothing happening.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-find-a-club/shots/007-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-find-a-club/shots/007-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261106-1915-jordan-find-a-club` step 5 — “organizers aren't even here? so I'm asking... nobody?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-find-a-club/shots/005-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-find-a-club/shots/005-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261106-1915-minji-find-a-club` step 10 — “3 tabs, 다 비었어. so the only real thing here is the Ask to join button” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-minji-find-a-club/shots/010-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-minji-find-a-club/shots/010-click-som.jpg)

Runs: [`sched-20261106-1915-jordan-find-a-club`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-jordan-find-a-club/report.md), [`sched-20261106-1915-minji-find-a-club`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261106-1915-minji-find-a-club/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `jordan-sophomore-impatient`, `minji-freshman-17` · scenarios: `find-a-club`

### Environment note

Members empty is partly local (no other students); events/organizers come from the same imported data as live — likely the same there.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Hide empty tabs; show the club's official site/Instagram and usual meeting time; say exactly who receives the request (e.g. "we email the officers listed on CalLink").

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).
